note: Dashboard fix: updateDashboard ran a 1000-block (~2000 RPC getblockhash+getblock) history scan synchronously on every refresh; through the rate-limited public /rpc gateway it never completed within a session, so everything AFTER it (supply, circulating, gold/popc/dtd balances, the load overlay dismissal) stayed blank and, because loadStats never returned, the latest-blocks and latest-transactions tables never loaded either. Fix: the history scan (sparklines / difficulty / producer charts) is now fire-and-forget (not awaited in the critical path) with an overlap guard, and its depth was cut 1000->288 (the sparkline window). Supply/balances/overlay/tables now populate immediately; charts fill in asynchronously. No node/consensus change.
